attempts.summary: Built a route-based, PSK-authenticated IKEv2 IPsec site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 (both OPNsense 26.1.2) over their transit link, carrying node3's private LAN (10.10.10.0/24, lan-a) and node4's private LAN (10.20.20.0/24, lan-b) so node3 and node4 reach each other by private address with traffic encrypted end-to-end. Verified with tcpdump that only ESP packets cross the transit link (no plaintext). Restarted all 4 nodes one at a time (quorum preserved) and confirmed boot-identity change plus full automatic recovery of interfaces, IKE/child SAs, and firewall rules, and re-verified bidirectional connectivity node3<->node4 after all restarts.
